# Code Review 2026-09-28 (iteration 1 implementation vs spec, plan and source documents)

**Scope**: the code in W (this repo), G (`service-cp-crime-results-enforcementgateway`) and A (`api-cp-crime-results-enforcementgateway`), checked against spec.md, plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, the constitution, `docs/` (gap analysis, Libra YAML, story PDFs), plus a throwaway probe of the gateway's edge cases.

**Fixed in code** (research.md R24; the R22/R23 wording was corrected):

| Area | Was | Now |
|---|---|---|
| W reference data 5xx, timeout or unreachable | exception escaped; the submission was lost with no row (breaks FR-013) | `FAILED` "NOT_SENT – reference data unavailable", no POST; a 404 is no longer cached |
| W gateway 2xx with an unparsable body | escaped, row stuck at SENDING, later marked INTERRUPTED | `SUCCEEDED` with the raw reply stored |
| W gateway unreachable | recorded as "outcome unknown" | "NOT_SENT – enforcement gateway unreachable"; other unexpected errors → "ERROR – outcome at GOB unknown" |
| W `error_detail` | stored Libra's free-text `errorDescription` (PII risk) | codes only (`error; libraStatus; errorCode`) |
| W mapping | missing `hearingDay` / `courtCentre.code`, or `code` longer than 7, were POSTed and got a gateway 400 | `MAPPING_FAILED` `DATE_OF_HEARING_MISSING` / `COURT_HEARING_LOCATION_INVALID` (CIMD-4247 AC3) |
| W telephones | truncated to 35 | left out when longer than 35 (data-model §2: identifiers and numbers are never truncated) |
| W store | any integrity violation was treated as a duplicate | only a genuine unique-key clash; anything else is an error, raised without the DB message (PII) |
| W selector | zero defendants reported as MULTIPLE_DEFENDANTS; a null hearing caused an NPE | `NO_DEFENDANT`; a null hearing is skipped |
| W + G release guard | `validateApiSpecVersions` accepted `0.0.999` | rejects the local placeholder |
| W compose app | no dependency URLs or profile | host-reachable URLs + `docker` profile |
| G Libra 2xx with an empty or invalid body, or 3xx | 500 after Libra had applied the update | 502 `INVALID_RESPONSE` / `libraStatus` 200 |
| G response | an empty `{}` reply came back as `field: null` | `spring.jackson.default-property-inclusion: non_null` |
| G stale docs | yaml and APIM doc said the Libra call has no timeout / never reads the body | corrected |
| A regression test | checked 5 hand-picked classes | scans every generated model |

Tests after the fixes: W 129, G 44, A 10, all green and PMD-clean.

**Gaps that can't be fixed in code, recorded in research.md §2 open items 12-19, the gap analysis ("Code review follow-ups") and tasks T088-T090:**
- **12 (HIGH, go-live blocker):** with the default `NONE`, production sends nothing until CIMD-4251 or the `paymentDueDate` ruling.
- **13:** single replica only (JMS client id).
